body.label: Target
body.html: A line of 5 spaces within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the line is difficult terrain for enemies and provides no cover bonus to creatures inside it.

surges.html: The line may turn once at a visible corner.
One enemy currently in the line takes 1 weapon Damage on a successful attack against its Fortitude.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: If your Locked target voluntarily moves into or along the line before your next turn, end Lock to halt that movement after its first unit. It may burn 1 die to continue.
